C4_prior_retrained_confounded.methodology_defect: Prior C4 retrained the ExtraTrees routing classifier with action 1 remapped to 2. This caused policy probability shift where action 0 (cheap MiniLM) was chosen for 99.5% of cases, confounding counter-evidence ablation with complete lack of LLM escalation.

causal_counter_evidence_effect.interpretation: Clean causal ablation reveals that targeted counter-evidence retrieval does NOT drive a 12.75 pp gain. Instead, overall accuracy remains identical (91.50% vs 91.50%), while removing counter-evidence actually REDUCES FRR from 14.67% down to 12.67%, confirming that unconstrained counter-evidence retrieval was harmful to supported claims.

evidence_sufficiency_ablation.interpretation: Zeroing out evidence sufficiency features (indices 9..12) at inference time reduces accuracy slightly from 91.50% to 90.50% (-1.00 pp), demonstrating modest feature attribution without destabilizing the policy.
